description: Screen a cryptocurrency address against the US Treasury's OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Returns whether the address is designated, the designating entity and programmes, and the publish date of the list used. The list is public-domain US Government data, so the answer is deterministic and needs no third-party provider. Choose this to screen a cryptocurrency address against the OFAC SDN list before a transfer or onboarding, when a deterministic, sourced compliance answer with the list's publish date is what you need. Do not choose this as a complete sanctions or AML programme: it covers only the OFAC SDN list's digital-currency addresses, and a no-match result is not a statement that an address is lawful. Example requests: Is this crypto address on the OFAC sanctions list? | Screen 0x252a8bd2319d8a555b872990601221b3a2053bce for sanctions. | Check whether this wallet is a sanctioned address before I send funds.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

address.description: The cryptocurrency address to screen (EVM, BTC, TRX, SOL, ...).

chain.description: Optional ticker to narrow the match (e.g. ETH, XBT, TRX, SOL). Default: match on any currency.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
